projects.name: for comprehensive 6–9 month DMAIC engagement managing cross-functional teams across frontline representatives, SMEs, Quality, Legal, Risk C Compliance—demonstrating project delivery discipline, stakeholder governance, and milestone tracking.
details: Applied systematic problem-solving: Pareto Analysis isolated root causes (two ISO code categories drove 60% of defects); Fishbone diagrams and 5 Whys traced systemic drivers across People, Process, Knowledge, Systems, and Culture.

Delivered: 97% defect reduction (1,500 → 35–45 cases/month); $2M+ revenue protected; $2–3M blocked capital released. Implemented six improvement solutions: probing script redesign, ISO taxonomy clarification, embedded SME coaching, performance realignment, monitoring dashboards, knowledge overhaul.

Established Control phase governance: weekly reporting, quality audits, kaizen assessments, formal ownership transfer—preventing regression and institutionalizing continuous improvement. Earned AmEx Centurion Award 2024.

Process transformation: Applied Lean Six Sigma DMAIC methodology to redesign CDD/KYC work standards across a 48,000+ case inventory, lifting individual analyst productivity by 60% (25 → 40 cases/day) while raising processing quality from 90% to 99% — achieved through standardization and coaching, with zero added headcount.

CDD/EDD-specific improvement: Led Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) workflow redesigns that cut KYC processing time by 25%, while sustaining 100% adherence to regulatory and audit requirements across all reporting cycles.
Operational Excellence & Transformation at Scale
Applied Lean Six Sigma to 48,000+ case inventory: 60% productivity uplift (25 → 40 cases/day), 90% → 99% quality improvement through work standardization and coaching, not additional headcount.
Managed operational scale: 48,000+ case inventory at 98.5% quality score, 7–8 Units Per Hour (UPH), 90%+ system occupancy within strict regulatory SLA requirements.

Designed 20+ SOPs spanning process categorization, escalation governance, regulatory compliance, customer communication, merchant verification—enabling consistent execution and reducing errors across distributed teams.
Crisis Leadership & Change Management

Managed GO2 tool implementation crisis (Jan 2024): escalations surged 200 → 500/month. Deployed 6-person escalation team, redesigned workflows, reduced escalations to 350/month (30% improvement)—demonstrating crisis response and process agility.

Led transformations: Voice of Customer (Qualtrics) analysis recovered CSAT (70% → 82%), NPS (70% → 90%), AHT (500s → 400s, 20% reduction). Designed Extended Payment Terms Plans for 30+ accounts (₹90 lakhs annual savings).
Team Leadership & Capability Building
Led 25+ representatives through coaching, performance reviews, KPI dashboards. Improved engagement 15%, maintained 85% retention, developed 5 internal promotion candidates.
Reduced new-hire time-to-productivity by 20% through onboarding protocols and knowledge transfer—demonstrating organizational capability and change enablement.
